description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten and Vivi trigger.
Resolve the Vivi trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {U}{U/R}{U/R}{U/R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Vivi.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Hero's Blade triggers, attaching Hero's Blade to Vivi.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.
